en.headline: Financial Secretary ends investigation into Next Digital affairs
en.dek: Paul Chan directed the inspector to terminate the probe after the company was wound up, delisted and related national-security convictions were secured, saying further inquiry was no longer necessary.
body: The Financial Secretary has directed the inspector to terminate the investigation into the affairs of Next Digital Limited, the government announced on Wednesday. The inspector’s term of office expired on 27 July.

Paul Chan noted that the Court of First Instance granted a winding-up order against the company on 15 December 2021 and liquidation is ongoing. Its listing was cancelled by the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on 12 January 2023. Several former senior officers were convicted of offences endangering national security and sentenced to imprisonment in December 2025 and February 2026. Three subsidiaries were also convicted, fined and later struck off the Companies Register by order of the Chief Executive-in-Council on 24 March 2026.

Having reviewed these circumstances, the Financial Secretary considered further investigation unnecessary under the Companies Ordinance. He described the governance and financial problems at Next Digital, together with the unlawful acts of its senior officers, as an isolated incident. Hong Kong, he said, maintains a sound corporate-governance regime aligned with international standards, and the government, regulators and business community will continue to uphold high standards to safeguard the city’s status as an international financial centre.

zh.headline: 財政司司長指示終止調查壹傳媒事務
zh.dek: 陳茂波經審視清盤、除牌及國安相關定罪等情況後，認為已無需要繼續調查，並指示審查員終止有關工作。
body: 特區政府周三表示，財政司司長已根據《公司條例》指示審查員終止調查壹傳媒有限公司的事務，審查員的任期已於7月27日屆滿。
陳茂波指出，高等法院原訟法庭於2021年12月15日向壹傳媒頒令清盤，清盤程序仍在進行；其上市地位亦於2023年1月12日被取消。壹傳媒部分前高層人員已於2025年12月15日及今年2月9日被裁定危害國家安全罪名成立並判處監禁。三間子公司在相關刑事案件中被定罪及罰款，並於今年3月24日按行政長官會同行政會議命令從公司登記冊剔除，亦即告解散。
經詳細審視上述情況及所有相關因素後，財政司司長認為已沒有需要繼續對壹傳媒的事務進行調查。他強調，香港作為國際金融中心，具備良好、高效並與國際標準相符的公司管治制度。壹傳媒的管治及財政問題，以及其高層管理人員利用公司進行不法行為，純屬個別事件。政府、監管機構及商界將繼續共同努力，確保香港持續奉行良好企業文化及高標準公司管治，維護國際金融及商業中心的地位及信譽。
